title: Make mobile Gallery shells thin adapters
requires: Android or Apple mobile build toolchain
scope: Reduce Android JNI/Java and iPad UIKit code to OS lifecycle, semantic input translation, surface presentation and reporting around the common runtime.
acceptance: Neither mobile shell owns scene descriptions, controller rules, simulation timing or physics fallback policy.
Host and device tests cover shell recreation, surface replacement, pause/background and failure recovery.

history.reason: Shared mobile session owns scene controls, timing admission, lifecycle, surfaces, and failure recovery; Android and iPad shells now translate OS events and present shared state.
